data.name: Aneeqah
data.gender_notes: Aneeqah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aneeqah is derived from the Arabic word 'anīq', which means to free or deliver. It is a feminine name that signifies the one who helps and delivers others. The name Aneeqah carries the meaning “Deliverer, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aneeqah usually hope their child will grow to embody deliverer, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aneeqah represents the idea of freedom from the material world and the ability to connect with the spiritual realm. It symbolizes the release from the shackles of earthly desires and the pursuit of inner peace and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Aneeqah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Deliverer, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aneeqah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: عنيقة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني الجميلة والحسنة في الخلق والخلقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عربي مؤنث يعني الجميلة والحسنة في الخلق والخلقة، مشتق من العنيق وهو الشيء الحسن الجميل، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَلَهُ الْجَمَالُ وَالْحُسْنُ'، ويعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة وروحانية عالية

in_urdu.name: عنیقہ
in_urdu.meaning: عنيقہ نام معنی خوبصورت اور حسن خلق
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی زبان سے ماخوذ، عنيقہ کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت اور حسن خلق، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں بہت مقبول ہے، اور اس کا مطلب حسن و جمال کے ساتھ جڑا ہوا ہے، جو اسلامی تقالید میں بہت اہم ہے

in_hindi.name: अनीक़ा
in_hindi.meaning: अनीक़ा नाम का अर्थ सुंदर और अच्छे चरित्र का है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अनीक़ा एक सुंदर और अच्छे चरित्र वाली लड़की के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण नाम है, जो भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है, और इसका अर्थ सुंदरता और अच्छे चरित्र के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है

in_pashto.name: عنيقه
in_pashto.meaning: عنيقه نوم معنی ښکل او پټی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د پښتو ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی، عنيقه نوم ښکل او پټی معنی لري، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو کې ډیر مشهور دی، او د ښکل او پټی سره تړلی دی، کوم چې د اسلامي دودیزو کې ډیر مهم دی

in_english.name: Aneeqah
in_english.long_meaning: Aneeqah is a female given name that originates from Arabic, meaning beautiful and good-natured, lovely creation. It is derived from the Arabic root 'ع ن ق' which connotes the idea of beauty and goodness. The name has been used in various Muslim cultures and is associated with positive personality traits such as kindness, compassion, and inner beauty. In Islamic tradition, the name is considered to be of great significance, reflecting the values of beauty, morality, and spirituality

data.cultural_impact: The name Aneeqah holds a special place in Islamic culture as it signifies the spirit of compassion, kindness, and aid to others. In Islamic societies, helping and serving others is considered one of the most admirable traits, and the name Aneeqah embodies this quality. Thus, it is common for parents to name their daughters Aneeqah as a reminder for them to grow up to be selfless and helping individuals.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Aneeqah resonates with the qualities of mercy, compassion, and generosity. In the Quran, Allah is described as the "Lord of the Two Easts and Wests, Forgiving, Merciful" (Al-Rahman 55:1), emphasizing the virtues of forgiveness and mercy. The name Aneeqah is therefore a constant reminder for the bearer to embody these divine virtues and to strive towards delivering others from their troubles and hardships, just as Allah delivers us from our trials and tribulations.
